title: % w/v (Weight per Volume)

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

expression: % w/v = (mass of solute in grams / volume of solution in mL) × 100
explanation: Expresses concentration as grams of solute per 100 mL of final solution — common for describing solid reagents dissolved in a liquid (e.g. '2% w/v NaCl').

workedExample.scenario: 2 g of solute dissolved to a final volume of 100 mL.

commonMistakes: Confusing % w/v with % w/w (weight per weight) — they are not the same for non-water solvents/dilute vs. concentrated solutions.
